materialResults: Ordinary reviewer self-decisions fail closed; claimant/reviewer conflicts are surfaced.
The official Franklin Navigator first-party profile is protected from ordinary public claim creation while free factual-correction access remains available.
Reviewer sign-in shows visible progress and the active reviewer identity.
Submitted evidence destinations are visible before opening and generic-homepage evidence is warned about.
Reviewer navigation uses clearer review-request wording.
Pending profile access copy is state-aware and no longer implies a duplicate submission.
Reviewer handoff no longer places the signed-in account email in the URL fragment.
Correction/removal requests bind to the canonical selected profile rather than trusting a mutable incoming URL.
Removal requests use structured relationship choices, require a reason and authority confirmation, support evidence, and require explicit final confirmation.
Correction/removal paths expose a direct return to the exact profile, signed-in contact prefilling, direct removal action, and a correction alternative for non-authorized reporters.
English/Spanish material labels and regression/browser coverage were updated.
infrastructureCarryForward: A Franklin-controlled custom hostname for the privileged reviewer workspace remains an infrastructure/DNS task because the connected Render tooling does not expose custom-domain mutation.
Resume the owner live-path review after the final public deployment and capture newly observed issues in the next release.
